manual.tank.line2: The Tank is a multiblock that provides space for large amounts of fluid.{0}
manual.tank.line3: It will store up to 512 buckets of any fluid, which can be piped in via the top or bottom port.{0}
manual.tank.line4: The structure can be constructed out of any sheetmetal, it is not limited to using iron.{0}
manual.tank.line5: Fluids can only be extracted from the bottom center block.{0}
manual.tank.line6: Applying a redstone signal to the bottom center block will make the tank output automatically, a comparator placed there will emit a redstone signal proportional to how full the tank is.{0}
manual.tank.line7: Attaching the comparator to one of the top 4 layers results in a signal proportional to the height of the comparator.{0}
manual.tank.line8: For example, a comparator attached to the second layer of a tank would not emit any signal until the tank is 1/4 full and have a signal strength of 15 if the tank is half full or more.
